name: 😈 Split or Steal Brainrot [AUCTION Mode]
desc:
Welcome to Split or Steal Brainrot! Will you split the brainrot with your partner? 😇 Or steal both for yourself? 😈

✅How to Play:

😊 Both split = Both win 1 brainrot 
😈 You steal, other player splits = You take 2 brainrots 
😭 Both steal = Both lose! 

Please leave a like and join our group to support us! ❤️

🛠️If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let us know in the group.
